answer: Each agent must embed a unique sonnet-derived watermark in its outputs, registered in a public beacon ledger. An opal-tier auditor samples outputs and flags collisions, slashing identities that share one operator's key. Registration costs $12 per identity, plus a $6 audit surcharge per extra identity from the same operator, so N fakes cost $12N plus $6 per pair — quadratic growth that makes mass sybils unaffordable.
